claims: The Artemis II mission is estimated to cost approximately $4.1 billion to $4.2 billion per launch.
The cost of the Artemis II mission covers the operation of the Space Launch System (SLS) rocket and the Orion crew capsule.
The total Artemis program expenditures, including development, are expected to exceed $100 billion by the time humans land on the moon again.
The NASA Inspector General estimated the cost per individual launch (like Artemis II) to be around $4.1 billion in a 2021/2022 projection.
The overall Artemis program is frequently cited to cost over $90-$100 billion by the mid-2020s.
Combined, the Space Launch System rocket and Orion spacecraft have cost more than $44 billion to develop.
